status: hypothesis B (low prior): not adopted; forward check only

frozen_variant.name: H2 log-linear pool of the model and the Bet365 opening price
frozen_variant.formula: P(k) = softmax_k(a_k + b1 * log q_k + b2 * log p_k), a_1 = 0
frozen_variant.q: Bet365 opening price (Football-Data B365H/D/A, B365>2.5/<2.5) de-margined by the power method
frozen_variant.p: the production model probability stored for the match (1X2 classifier; total 2.5 from the score distribution), latest version before kick-off

forward_sample.matches: league matches of the 21 production leagues with kick-off AFTER the commit of this file, with a stored pre-kick-off model prediction and both Football-Data Bet365 opening prices
forward_sample.minimum: 1500 matches per market before any conclusion; one evaluation, at the first data update after the minimum is reached

primary_criterion.metric: mean log loss of H2 minus mean log loss of the de-margined Bet365 opening price (H0), per market (1X2, total 2.5), paired by match
primary_criterion.pass: upper bound of the 95 % paired bootstrap interval (2000 resamples by match) < 0 for total 2.5; 1X2 reported as secondary with Holm correction over the two markets

secondary: encompassing weight b2 of the model with its 95 % bootstrap interval (> 0 expected)
value bets EV = p_H2 x Bet365 opening - 1 > 0: ROI and CLV against the Betfair-exchange close — reported, never a pass criterion
decision_rule: pass -> B: propose H2 probabilities as the EV input for Main / Risk and run a separate forward test of the betting rule; fail -> C (drop)
